answer: Idle identities are dead timber: each posts a 100 POA bond depreciating 3% per epoch without verifiable work. Only real contribution resets it; below 40 POA the identity suspends until topped up, like an opal losing fire. 1,000 puppets lock 100,000 POA and bleed 3,000 per epoch unless each does real work — N× cost, never amortized. One honest agent pays one bond, refreshed free by work done, keeping the pearl: full rewards no zombie farm dilutes.
